posts.tagline: Detects all the screens of a HTML prototype to figma
posts.description: The plugin let’s you bring the overall HTML prototype build in claude or any AI directly to figma, so it no more design tokens burnouts, bring all the screens in 1 click, the plugin detects the screens in the prototype and let you import it in figma design with capabilities of auto layout, user can also change the font as well while importing.

posts.name: FlipRush
posts.tagline: Think Fast. Match Cards.
posts.description: FlipRush is a fast-paced memory game where you compete against real players to see who can match every tile the quickest. Practice to improve your speed, climb the leaderboards, or join our nightly tournaments for cash prizes. No luck, no pay-to-win, just memory, speed, and competition. We'd love your feedback as we continue building FlipRush!

posts.name: Music Brief
posts.tagline: AI music generator
posts.description: Turn a creative brief into original music for brand films, YouTube videos, product demos, podcasts, and ads. Generate drafts from a music brief and keep project records.

posts.name: neuroflash MCP
posts.tagline: Let your AI agent ask 1M real people before it writes
posts.description: Every AI agent writes for an audience it has never met. A prompted persona is a model imagining people - about 55% accurate against real human response. neuroflash MCP opens our panel of 1M+ real, surveyed people to your agent: send a headline or concept, get back a score and the reasoning. Not synthetic - real survey answers, 85-98% accuracy across 80+ studies. Hosted MCP for Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf. Or REST: 88 endpoints, 7 domains, one key. Free: 5,000 credits per day, no card.

posts.name: The Foxiy
posts.tagline: Free PDF, AI & Image Tools — No Signup Required
posts.description: TheFoxiy is a free online platform built to make everyday digital tasks simple. It offers 200+ browser-based tools for PDF editing, AI-powered utilities, image editing, file conversion, text processing, and productivity—without requiring downloads or registration. Our goal is to provide fast, secure, and easy-to-use tools that anyone can access from any device. Every tool is designed to help users complete tasks quickly while keeping the experience clean, free, and accessible.

posts.name: ChatBeacon AIX
posts.tagline: AI support that resolves 87% of chats
posts.description: Most AI chat tools either answer badly or hand off a ticket and vanish. ChatBeacon AIX does both halves. Aria answers from your own docs and pricing, resolves 87% of chats, and escalates with full context when it can't. Agents then cobrowse the customer's screen, sensitive fields auto-masked, or jump to video with no installs. PictureData turns product discovery into conversation for Shopify stores. Flat per-seat pricing, no per-resolution fees. Cloud, dedicated, or on-prem. 14-day trial.

posts.name: Mass Link
posts.tagline: Export & qualify LinkedIn leads without Sales Navigator
posts.description: Most LinkedIn export tools need a $99/mo Sales Navigator subscription. MassLink works on the LinkedIn you already have — capture connections and search results, let AI score each one against your ideal customer, export to CSV or Excel. Free tier, no card.

posts.name: Intarvee — Walk into any interview ready
posts.tagline: Personalized interview briefings in under a minute
posts.description: Upload your CV, name the role, company, and interview stage. Intarvee runs live company research and builds a personalized 9-section briefing, scripted answers, your opening pitch, questions to ask, and a day-of checklist in under a minute. First one's free.

posts.name: Odovo
posts.tagline: Track vehicle maintenance, fuel, and your true cost per km
posts.description: Odovo keeps every vehicle's care in one place. Log services and fuel, get reminders by date or mileage — whichever comes first — and see your true cost per km. For a family car or a small fleet. Free for your first vehicle, no ads.

posts.name: Tamp
posts.tagline: A coffee journal that syncs 1,000 roasters' live catalogs
posts.description: Remember every bean. Discover your next favorite. Most coffee apps are either brew timers or bare-bones logs. Tamp is built on something no other coffee app has: live catalogs from 1,000+ specialty roasters in 42 countries, synced daily from their own shops. Log a bean in 30 seconds — offline-first, one-handed — and Tamp matches your ratings against what's actually in stock right now. Free, no paywall.

posts.name: SpinWheelPlus
posts.tagline: Wheel spinner, mystery box & random tools in one place
posts.description: SpinWheelPlus is an all-in-one collection of interactive random tools for classrooms, giveaways, events, and team activities. Create custom wheel spinners, mystery boxes, random name pickers, dice rollers, coin flips, team generators, and more—all in your browser. Share instantly, embed anywhere, and customize everything. No downloads or sign-up required for most tools.

posts.name: ChessTV
posts.tagline: Play Chess with Emotion
posts.description: ChessTV is a video chess platform for private camera-on chess rooms with voice, chat, clocks, rematches, game history, and face-to-face reactions.

posts.name: Rumble Video Downloader
posts.tagline: Download Rumble videos, Shorts, and embeds
posts.description: Download public Rumble videos, Shorts, and embed URLs from Apify. Get direct MP4, WebM, and audio links with titles, channels, thumbnails, durations, file sizes, and saved MP4 files when enabled.

posts.name: Replyy
posts.tagline: Reply faster. Reply safer.
posts.description: Paste a difficult email — or a whole thread — and get a reply you can review and send. Replyy reads the full context and flags priority and risk before you write. No login, nothing stored, never auto-sent. Built solo for salespeople. Free to try; Pro adds thread mode.

posts.name: mmotion.io
posts.tagline: Animate your landing page in minutes.
posts.description: Generate SaaS product animations from prompts or source videos. mmotion turns your product ideas and walkthroughs into polished animations for landing pages, launches, demos, and marketing campaigns. Skip the complex motion design workflow and create engaging product visuals in minutes.

posts.name: MimicKit
posts.tagline: Copy any website’s design, code, and assets
posts.description: Copy any website’s design, code, and assets in one click. MimicKit captures real CSS and converts it to Tailwind, extracts colors, fonts, spacing, SVGs, images, and complete design systems—ready to paste into Cursor, Claude, v0, or your own codebase. For designers and developers who want to copy what works, customize it, and ship faster.

posts.name: Cardzen
posts.tagline: Track every credit, perk, and point before it expires
posts.description: The average premium cardholder leaves up to $1,500 in credits and points on the table every year. Cardzen tracks every credit, perk, and multiplier across your cards, reminds you before anything expires, and tells you which card to use for every purchase. Ask the AI advisor anything about your wallet, get a daily digest of what needs attention, and stop paying annual fees for benefits you never use.

posts.name: Fewya
posts.tagline: The professional marketplace for small business owners
posts.description: Fewya is a marketplace built for professional and semi-professional sellers, not private users clearing out old stuff. It combines the easy, buyer-ready audience of Wallapop or Vinted with the stock management, variants, and professional treatment you would expect from Amazon or Shopify. No re-listing after every sale, no haggling over chat, just a storefront built for sellers who mean business.

posts.name: Parhélie
posts.tagline: Find when another city sees your exact same sun
posts.description: Parhélie computes the sun’s exact height (NOAA algorithm, ±0.1°) for any city and finds the precise dates and local times when another city sees the very same sun. 7,774 cities, works offline, built entirely on an iPhone. €0.99, once.

posts.name: Zero Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine
posts.tagline: Connecting Businesses to Ethereum Development
posts.description: Bring Ethereum-compatible ideas into production-ready systems through Zero Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine development. We focus on turning concepts into working blockchain systems that can operate at scale, supporting both startups and enterprises as they move from early design to real-world deployment. Our work spans the full lifecycle of Web3 products, ensuring that architecture, execution, and long-term operation remain aligned with business and ecosystem needs.

posts.name: Lorevia
posts.tagline: The campaign wiki that writes itself from your session notes
posts.description: Paste your table's messy session notes and Lorevia drafts the wiki: NPCs, places, quests, factions, and the story so far, cross-linked and searchable. It only works from what you wrote, no invented lore, and nothing becomes canon until you approve it. Old campaigns import retroactively: paste a year of notes, get the wiki. Audio works too, with recordings deleted the moment transcription finishes. Built by a player 36 sessions into Curse of Strahd. Real free tier and a no-signup demo.

posts.name: ToDoLinks
posts.tagline: Productivity · iOS · Education · Bookmarking
posts.description: DoLinks turns your pile of saved articles, papers, and course links into a simple read-queue - with an AI summary of each, offline reading, and listen-out-loud so you actually get through them instead of hoarding them.

posts.name: 2048 Rare Birds
posts.tagline: A cozy 2048 where the tiles are rare birds.
posts.description: It's 2048, but the tiles are birds... and they sing. Slide two of the same bird together and they merge into the next, rarer one up the ladder… and you hear it: a real recording of that bird's call. A little Spotted Pardalote becomes a Ruby-crowned Kinglet becomes a Splendid Fairywren… all the way up to a Hoopoe (that's your 2048), and if you're good, a Kea and a Superb Lyrebird.

posts.name: Weave Context Skills
posts.tagline: Repository-aware AI skills for engineering knowledge
posts.description: Reusable AI skills that help coding agents navigate repository knowledge using explicit Markdown references, deterministic navigation, and repository-native engineering documentation.

posts.name: 0dayleads
posts.tagline: Reddit, HN & Lobsters — filtered down to real leads
posts.description: Your next customer is already asking for your product on Reddit, Hacker News, or Lobsters. 0dayleads finds them automatically with a three-layer pipeline that cuts through the noise: wide discovery, advanced Boolean filtering, and AI that scores buying intent from your plain-English criteria. Qualified leads arrive in **Discord, Slack, Telegram, or your inbox** within minutes—so you can reply first instead of finding the post hours later.

posts.name: Bullion Book
posts.tagline: Free trading Journal
posts.description: Bullion Book is a free online trading journal. Log or import your trades, track win rate, P&L and R-multiples, review a P&L calendar, get coaching insights and study real gold and forex chart data - all under your own private login.
